title: Dilation averaging estimate on the boundary annulus of the unit ball
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let F : ℝⁿ → ℝ be measurable with F ≥ 0 and F integrable on B := B̆_1(0) (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), and let 0 < s ≤ 1/2. Put A_s := B ∖ B̆_{1−s}(0). Then ∫_{A_s} (∫_{1/2}^1 F(tx) dt) dx ≤ 2^{n+1} s ∫_B F, with Bochner integrals and an interval integral inside.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → ℝ) (s : ℝ), Measurable F → (∀ y, 0 ≤ F y) → IntegrableOn F (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1) → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 2 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1 \ ball (0 : Euclid n) (1 - s), (∫ t in (1 / 2 : ℝ)..1, F (t • x)) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) * s * ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, F y
